test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Sunita borrows ₹5,500 for 3 years at 6.5% per annum simple interest. She immediately lends it to Vedanshi at 9.3% per annum simple interest for 3 years. Find her gain (in ₹) in the transaction per year.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal borrowed by Sunita (P₁) = ₹5,500

Rate of interest for borrowing (R₁) = 6.5% per annum

Time for borrowing (T) = 3 years

Principal lent to Vedanshi (P₂) = ₹5,500

Rate of interest for lending (R₂) = 9.3% per annum

Time for lending (T) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

Gain per year = SI (from Vedanshi) - SI (paid to lender) &
